{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\")
print(df.head())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values per column:")
print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values and distributions
print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:")
print(df['customer_segment'].unique())

print("\nDistribution of converted:")
print(df['converted'].value_counts(normalize=True))

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:")
print(df['status'].value_counts())

# Check if converted is binary
print("\nUnique values in converted:")
print(df['converted'].unique())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print("\nRows with revenue == '999999.99':")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("\nCount of customer_age == -1:")
print((df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
